outcome: Persistence of pulmonary hypertension at 1 month of age
Persistence of pulmonary hypertension at 1 year of age
cohort: The study included 88 neonates with a congenital diaphragmatic hernia.
finding: Despite high initial prevalence and impact on mortality, pulmonary hypertension resolved within weeks of surgery in most surviving neonates, with the duration of invasive ventilation being a key factor in its persistence at 1 year.
